# Problem 1
```{r}
data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")
```
The `penguins` dataset contains information about penguins, including their species (`r paste(unique(penguins$species), collapse = ', ')`); island (`r paste(unique(penguins$island), collapse = ', ')`); bill length; bill depth; flipper length; body mass; sex (`r paste(unique(penguins$sex), collapse = ', ')`); and year of observation (`r paste(unique(penguins$year), collapse = ', ')`).

The size of the dataset is `r nrow(penguins)` observations and `r ncol(penguins)` variables. The mean flipper length is `r round(mean(penguins$flipper_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE), 2)` mm.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
ggplot(penguins, aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = flipper_length_mm, color = species)) + geom_point()
```
